name: Doll's Play
source:
Dolly, having lost her arms, relies on her girlfriend, Athena, to live her day-to-day life. Feelings of inadequacy plague her all the while. Weirdness ensues.

[From [url=https://outootome.itch.io/dolls-play]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
失去双臂的多莉依靠她的女朋友雅典娜过着日常生活。无力感一直困扰着她。奇怪的事情随之而来。

[来自[url=https://outootome.itch.io/dolls-play]itch.io[/url]]
